subject: SOC 2 onboarding: initial Type II report request + checklist
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Iris Walker <iris.walker@praxiscloud.com>, security@praxiscloud.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 onboarding: initial Type II report request + checklist

Hi Iris / Praxis security team,

Thanks for the note — happy to get a SOC 2 Type II package over to help with your procurement review. To help your team move quickly, below is what we can share and a short checklist of the common items customers request during onboarding.

Audit period we typically provide: 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 (we can confirm exact dates in the PDF). If you need a bridge letter that covers a gap between that period and your contract start date, we can provide a short bridge letter template alongside the report.

What we can provide immediately (redacted where appropriate):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — completeness: controls tested, auditor opinion, exceptions noted.
- Bridge letter template (DOCX) for interim coverage (if required).
- Initial evidence checklist (CSV) with pointers to commonly requested artifacts (logs, change control records, encryption descriptions).
- Transfer instructions (MD) describing secure upload options and acceptable redaction practices.

Quick checklist (high-priority items that procurement/security requests):
1) Control description & auditor opinion (SOC 2 Type II) — report file.
2) Bridge letter covering the interim period (if audit window does not cover go-live).
3) Subservice organization / vendor attestations (if any outsourced controls were used).
4) Encryption at rest & in transit summary (KMS, algorithms).
5) Access control matrix and recent access review cadence.
6) Incident response summary for the audit period (high-level, no PII).
7) Pen test summary (date, remediation status).
8) Retention and deletion policy for customer data.
9) List of environment names/regions and data residency where applicable.
10) Contact for follow-up — we can route technical asks to Sean (cc'd).

Standard reply template you can paste into procurement to confirm acceptance: 
"Redwood has provided a SOC 2 Type II report for the audit period 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 and a bridge letter template. We request the redacted report and bridge letter be uploaded to a secure share for vendor verification. Contact: Iris Walker (security@praxiscloud.com)."

Preferred transfer options: secure Drive folder (we can pre-configure a restricted link), temporary S3 presigned upload, or Box. We generally accept redactions around specific employee names/IDs; auditors' opinion language and control IDs should remain intact.

If that checklist looks good, can you confirm: 1) whether you need a bridge letter; 2) preferred transfer method; and 3) an internal timeline (e.g., 7 business days)?

I can upload the report to a restricted folder once I have your preferred method. Sean (cc) will handle any technical questions about encryption or network isolation.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Security Sales
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025-10-01_2026-03-31.pdf (redacted), SOC2-Bridge-Letter-template.docx, Initial-Evidence-Checklist.csv, Secure-Upload-Instructions.md

From: Iris Walker <iris.walker@praxiscloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: security@praxiscloud.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 onboarding: initial Type II report request + checklist

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear note and checklist. A few clarifications before we pull procurement/policy in: 

- Confirming we are asking specifically for a SOC 2 Type II report covering your stated audit period (2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31).
- We generally accept a bridge letter for interim coverage; can you confirm whether the bridge letter will be signed by your auditor or whether it is a customer-ready template we should expect to see with your signature?
- For the subservice orgs: please call out any third-party cloud providers or CDNs that were part of controls testing and include their attestation references.
- We also need a 1-paragraph description of your encryption-at-rest (KMS provider, algorithm family) and key management practices. High level is fine.

Preferred upload: secure Drive folder link (restricted to invited emails) — can you share that?

If you can upload the redacted report + bridge letter template and the Initial-Evidence-Checklist into a restricted folder by EOD Monday (2026-06-15), that will allow our procurement team to get back to you quickly.

Thanks —
Iris Walker
Security Lead, PraxisCloud Inc.
iris.walker@praxiscloud.com
